Definition: Whether the civil registration and digital ID systems are integrated
Comments: PRODIGY project explicitly links civil registration modernization with digital ID. Toamasina digital civil registration pilot launched June 2023. IN Groupe contracted to modernize civil registry. Integration underway but not fully complete nationally.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed. Fetched sources plus a fresh June 2026 report confirm the NUI enrolment is deliberately built on the civil registry ("civil registration model helps country surpass enrolment target"), and the PRODIGY design documents interoperable CR/ID databases as a core objective, but full nationwide integration is not yet complete (rural rollout still pending). Partial integration (code 2) remains the accurate score.

Definition: Whether the country has established or is actively developing a national digital identity system, including foundational ID systems that enable authentication across multiple services. Fully deployed means operational nationwide and accepting new registrations.
Comments: Madagascar has a legacy CIN (Carte d'Identité Nationale, compulsory from age 18) and launched a pilot biometric digital ID (NUI/PRODIGY) in January 2026 with nationwide rollout planned from April 2026. System not yet universally deployed.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Score changed from 2 (Planning) to 4 (Partially deployed). A 5 June 2026 Biometric Update report confirms 2.6 million citizens enrolled between April and June 2026 (exceeding the 2 million target), with an ~8 million rural expansion still to come later in 2026 — this is well beyond "planning" and matches "partially deployed nationwide".

Definition: Whether credential is accepted or mandatory for opening bank accounts and accessing financial services
Comments: The CIN (national identity card) is the primary KYC document required to open a bank account in Madagascar (confirmed by SmileID and US State Dept guide). AML/KYC Law n°2018-043 reinforces this requirement.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Score changed from 2 (Accepted but not mandatory) to 3 (Mandatory). Retail bank account-opening requirements published by BGFIBank Madagascar and MCB Madagascar both list a copy of the CIN (or passport for foreign nationals) as a required document, not an optional one, under AML/KYC Law n°2018-043 — this is a mandatory requirement rather than merely "accepted".

Comments: Government announced through Ministry of Interior that acquiring an Identification Card is 'completely FREE' (March 2025 announcement). The new NUI biometric ID under PRODIGY is also being issued free of charge. Previously a small fiscal stamp fee (1,000-5,000 Ariary) was charged.

revision_notes: Confirmed, with better sourcing. L'Express de Madagascar (8 April 2026, "le processus gratuit") and Digigasy (26 Feb 2026, "l'opération est entièrement gratuite'') independently confirm the new NUI biometric enrolment is free. The residual fiscal-stamp fee noted at guide.za-malagasy.com (Oct 2025) appears to relate to the legacy CIN renewal process rather than the new biometric enrolment; original single Facebook source replaced with two independent news sources.

Definition: Whether registration for digital ID is mandatory, optional, or mandatory for specific groups
Comments: CIN possession is compulsory for Malagasy citizens from age 18 (Decree 78-277, 1978). The new NUI biometric system was approved by Council of Ministers. Government announcements frame it as a national initiative for all citizens. Enforcement capacity limited in practice.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Score changed from 2 (Mandatory for some) to 3 (Mandatory for all). The World Bank's ID4D Country Diagnostic states CIN registration "is required by law for all Malagasy citizens older than 18 years of age", and Wikipedia's identity-card table independently confirms possession is compulsory under Decree 78-277 — the legal requirement is universal for the eligible (adult) population, not limited to specific groups, though enforcement in practice is acknowledged to be imperfect.

Definition: Whether credential is accepted or mandatory for SIM card activation and mobile service registration
Comments: Madagascar requires national ID or passport registration for all SIM cards per telecommunications regulations. PikaSim and prepaid SIM wiki confirm mandatory registration. No confirmed electronic verification against national ID database as yet.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Score changed from 2 (Accepted but not mandatory) to 3 (Mandatory). ARTEC's regulation (arrêté n°2016-2417) obliges all mobile operators to suspend unidentified SIM lines and requires official ID for every SIM sale, with fines and imprisonment for non-compliance under Articles 39/41 of Law n°2005-023 — this is a binding legal mandate, not a merely accepted practice.
